name: P2b_distributed_material_observations
purpose: Disentangle material-observation spatial distribution, point count, and geometry/q localization; no application accuracy claim.

capture.frame_lists_note: Resolve from available replay, exclude prior development windows, freeze before test; same replay clips are not assumed statistically independent.
capture.target_blade_id_note: Source capture/evaluation identity and mapping unresolved; estimated target index is designed as blade0. Do not transmit source identity/binding to solver or reselect using test scores.

fairness.q: one shared 2D coordinate per track; RGB/estimated-template initialization only
fairness.loss_normalization: fixed total track-block convention, audit actual implementation; no test-time tuning
fairness.solver_budget: freeze after input-only/development numerical audit, same across groups

primary_metric: q-independent, area-weighted symmetric point-to-triangle distance on predeclared target surface region; fixed MODEL units, no per-group ICP

development_sensitivity.noise_model: estimated from input localization, include shared track bias and frame components
development_sensitivity.delta_dev_definition: Delta=E_A1-E_A3; delta_perturb=empirical P95(abs(Delta_perturbed-Delta_unperturbed)) across 20 paired development perturbations; delta_dev=max(delta_perturb, paired-gain absolute changes in numerical-method and sampling-density comparisons). Sensitivity only, not confidence interval.

proposed_research_gate.spatial_distribution_support: D4 vs C4 same-direction in at least 2/3 clips and average difference beyond development sensitivity; D12 alone insufficient
proposed_research_gate.no_leakage_scope: solver and texture must not read prohibited inputs; source truth may be read only by separated capture/evaluation

metrics_contract.proposed_direction_weighting: area normalized within each direction, equal 0.5 weights between directions
metrics_contract.proposed_mean_aggregation: equal 8 times per clip and equal 3 test clips; spatial area weighting retained
metrics_contract.proposed_p95: quantile of equally mixed area-weighted directional distributions, not mean of directional p95
metrics_contract.q_eval_sources: first WideInput image pixels and each frozen estimated template only

old_result_diagnostics.incremental_information: same reference state, noise whitening and fixed state-column scales; Js, Jtx, Jtq; feasible tangent/profile when constraints active
old_result_diagnostics.numerical_comparison: one predeclared scale-consistent dense/exact vs sparse/LSMR development comparison
old_result_diagnostics.unwrapped_angle_shift_diagnostic: same geometry with uniform psi+360k degrees; no framewise modulo
old_result_diagnostics.stop_if_numerical_difference: greater than one third of proposed minimum gain; diagnose before test

single_additional_correction.scope: one finite six-run matrix: all active state/q as zero-centered scaled increments; fixed absolute difference 1e-4*original scales; same objective/bounds/support/prior/budget/termination
single_additional_correction.rationale: uniform +360 geometry leaves different actual relative FD and coordinate-norm xtol; these are numerical risks to test, not yet a proven unique cause
single_additional_correction.source_code_policy: task-local adapter only; no old results or product modules overwritten

source_audit_note: Uploaded screenshot byte mismatch is external review evidence only; original manifests and failures preserved; no transfer cause inferred.

proposed_observation_gate.annotation_source: RGB candidates and explicit review/detection; never label Codex review as user human annotation
proposed_observation_gate.selection_sources: WideInput RGB only; never use WideEval or source geometry to select formal queries
